_context: LM-E practice and tests (LAUNCH-MONITOR-SPEC 3.5); lazy namespace. {target} is a distance with its unit, {club} a club name, {s} ± {e} a score and its uncertainty (score 0-100). Scores built on modelled carry are labelled estimated.
template.target.title: Target practice
template.target.body: Pick a target carry and a club, hit a few balls and see how far each one misses.
template.target.how: Each ball scores by how far it lands from the target: dead on is 100, a miss of a quarter of the target or more is 0.
template.gapping.title: Gapping session
template.gapping.body: Hit a few balls with each club to measure its real carry and the gaps between clubs.
template.gapping.meta: 5 balls per club · feeds the distance table
template.gapping.how: Finish one club before moving to the next. The results become distance-table samples; there is no score.
template.distance18.title: Distance control 18
template.distance18.body: Targets from 40 to 120 yd in 10 yd steps, two rounds, each round in random order.
template.distance18.how: The order is drawn and saved when you start; hit the targets in the numbered order shown.
template.clubs3.title: Full bag, 3 rounds
template.clubs3.body: One ball with every club per round, in random order, three rounds.
template.clubs3.how: Each club’s target is the median carry in your own distance table; clubs with fewer than 3 shots start from a general reference distance.
list.lead: Set up the targets first, record one slow-motion clip per ball with the Camera app, then import them together; clips are matched to targets by recording time.
compare_note: Scores are compared only with the same drill from the same camera angle: face-on cannot see left–right misses, so its scores are on a different scale.
how: Record each ball as a slow-motion clip with the Camera app, then come back and import; clips are matched in recording order to the targets still open.
no_carry: No carry for this ball, not scored
delete.title: Delete this drill?
delete.body: The targets and scores are deleted; imported swings stay in History.
empty.title: No drill in progress
empty.body: Choose a drill or test in Practice drills.
result.estimated: Scores come from estimated carry, not a measured distance
result.prev: Last time, same drill: {s} pts ({date}); difference {d} pts
result.no_prev: No earlier result of this drill from the same camera angle to compare with yet
result.misses: Miss per target (plus = long, minus = short)
result.bars: How far each ball missed its target
result.gapping_body: These balls are saved in History; the distance table uses them for each club’s carry and gaps.
import.maps_none: This batch does not go to any target
import.extra: {n} more clips than open targets: they are not matched (still saved as normal swings)
import.how: After you pick videos, each clip’s target shows here and can be changed.
